quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries press release: Daikin Applied Triples Modular Solutions Manufacturing (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: Daikin Applied opened its newly expanded Modular Solutions facility in Phoenix, Arizona (announced October 14, 2026), growing its modular manufacturing footprint from 58,000 to 191,000 square feet and increasing production capacity for custom-built hydronic and electric systems by approximately 150%. The facility enables in-house production and factory integration of Daikin-owned technologies including direct-to-chip Chilldyne liquid cooling distribution units (CDUs) and DDC Solutions S-Series rack containment, and is ramping to full production capacity. The company names the data center market among the sectors driving strong interest in factory-built cooling; GM of Modular Solutions Stephen McGee: the added capacity lets it support more customers and take on larger projects.
quarterly_data.figure: 58,000 to 191,000 square feet; production capacity up approximately 150%
